Name: Dayswork
Author: Bindicle
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of doing all the farm work yourself? Hire a Farmhand to handle the daily chores while you explore, fish, or just relax. Purchase a Farmhand Cabin from Robin and set up customized contracts to have your helper work crops, animals, machines, fish ponds, and more  [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Walk up to and click on the cabin to open the UI.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Note: This mod does not work with multiplayer at this time.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Install SMAPI[/b] — Download and follow setup instructions from [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi.io[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Download this mod[/b] — Extract the  [/color][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Dayswork[/color][/size][color=#D4D4D8] folder into your [/color][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color][/size][color=#D4D4D8] directory[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Launch the game[/b] through SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][i]Optional:[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Hire a Farmhand — [/b]Purchase a Farmhand Cabin from Robin and manage contracts from it[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Manage Seasonal Crops — [/b]Tell the farmhand which crops to plant each season; they'll buy the seeds automatically[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Manage Machines — [/b]Automatically collect finished output and reload machines from a configured input chest[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Manage Fish Ponds — [/b]Collect pond output each day without lifting a finger[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Animal Care — [/b]Feed, pet, and collect animal products including SVE animals and truffle digging[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Clearing & Fieldwork — [/b]Cut trees, clear rocks, pull weeds, and more[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Flexible Work Scope — [/b]Define work zones, choose animal buildings, and include or exclude the greenhouse[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Priority System — [/b]Drag to reorder tasks; the farmhand tackles higher-priority work first[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Energy Tiers — [/b]Choose Half Day, Full Day, or Overtime to balance cost and output[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Smart Deposits — [/b]Items go to configured chests or the shipping bin; overflow is safely caught[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Festival-Aware & SVE Compatible —[/b] Respects holidays; supports SVE locations and animal types[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Tool Inheritance  — [/b]Upgraded tools make your farmhand more efficient[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] — Required for running SMAPI mods[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — [i]Optional[/i] — Adds an in-game config menu for easier settings adjustment[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fishing[/*]
[*]Mining[/*]
[*]Multiple farmhands[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support[/*]
[/list]
